images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: Eleven beds stood where the ward had been built for seven, and the lamp at the nurses' table was turned down to a bead.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Enajst postelj je stalo tam, kjer je bil oddelek zgrajen za sedem, svetilka pri mizi medicinskih sester pa je bila znižana na drobno žerjavico.
